Hi Olivia — great to hear you're ready to kick off.

High level we can meet your timeline. Proposed MAP items (short list):
1) Org & tenant: Redwood will spin a dedicated test org for BridgeMed (isolated namespace). We need the account admin email and preferred org name.
2) API keys: We'll issue a scoped API key for evaluation (limited quota). We recommend a single service account per integration and rotation every 30 days for POC.
3) IP allowlist: provide the egress IPs/CIDRs you will use. We will also provide a sample allowlist entry for your firewall.
4) VPC peering: we support AWS VPC peering and Transit Gateway. We'll share a peering template and the required console steps.

Can you confirm the target date you'd like the environment ready? We can aim for 2027-11-14 if your team is OK.

Looping in Neha (security/onboarding) and Priyom (map orchestration) to document technical steps and owners. I'll draft a concise MAP spreadsheet and share a link to sign-off items.

Thanks,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP Technical checklist and timeline (POC environment)

Hi Olivia — following up with a compact technical checklist to include in the MAP. I've kept this action-oriented so your infra and security teams can act quickly.

Action items (owner -> due):
1) BridgeMed: Confirm org name and email for admin -> owner: Olivia (due: 2027-11-04)
2) Redwood: Create tenant and invite BridgeMed admin -> owner: neha_kapoor (done after confirmation)
3) BridgeMed infra: Whitelist Redwood egress IPs (sample below) -> owner: networking team (due: 2027-11-09)
   - Sample allowlist entry: 52.33.128.0/20 (example); please provide your NAT egress CIDR(s) if different.
4) BridgeMed infra: Prepare VPC peering request (AWS us-west-2) using our template -> owner: BridgeMed network eng (due: 2027-11-09)
5) Redwood: Issue scoped API key and a service-account-based secret for POC; provide rotation instructions -> owner: priyom_das (target: 2027-11-10)
6) Joint: Smoke test generation and authentication (test vector + token) -> owners: bridge+redwood engs (target: 2027-11-14)

Files and artifacts attached: vpc-peering-template.json (peering configuration stub), ip-allowlist-sample.txt (copy/paste for firewall).

Notes / compliance:
- For the POC we will not store identifiable PHI in logs. If you plan to send sample patient data, let's add an NDA/case-specific agreement.
- If BridgeMed requires private peering (TGW) rather than classic VPC peering, escalate to solutions for the sizing call.

Proposed cadence:
- Today: finalize MAP owners and dates (this thread)
- Nov 9: infra complete (allowlist + peering request sent)
- Nov 10: Redwood issues API key and posts onboarding checklist
- Nov 14: end-to-end smoke tests + signoff to begin eval usage

Please reply with any changes to owners or dates. If these targets work, we'll publish a short MAP and an approvals link.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Onboarding & Security
Redwood Inference
